2026-05-05 merge: FYUM 2013 tur2b p7 is the n=300 numeric instance of this 3-regular four-cycle bound; the same counting proof applies after substitution.

2026-05-05: high-reasoning extraction from putnam-2002-b2-polyhedron-face-game-four-edge-face. The isolated ingredient is not merely the small Euler count; it packages the reusable large-face existence statement together with the local face-game fork strategy.
The statement is intentionally phrased for convex polyhedra/polyhedral embeddings so that face boundaries are cycles and neighboring faces along the chosen face are distinct.

The statement is self-contained in both schedule language and oriented one-factorization language.
